en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph showing a park-like area with tall trees and a view of a body of water in the background. There are benches and chairs arranged under a covered structure on the left side, with a wide open space in the middle ground. The setting has a historical, serene ambiance typical of early 20th-century European landscapes. The bottom half of the postcard includes printed text and a large, stamped mark indicating ownership by a museum.
